program.section_heading: Foreign Language for Professionals in Culinary Arts and Hospitality Careers Certificate
outcomes: Communication Skills: Students will be able to effectively use basic foreign language skills in various professional scenarios, including culinary instruction, customer service, and cross-cultural interactions within the hospitality industry with 70% accuracy.

Cultural Understanding: Students will deepen their understanding of the cultural norms, culinary traditions, and hospitality practices associated with the regions where the language they are studying is spoken with 70% accuracy.

Cross-Cultural Competence: Students will demonstrate the ability to navigate intercultural situations, show respect for diversity, and adapt within the multicultural work environments of the culinary arts and hospitality industries with 70% accuracy.

notes: Total discrepancy: the description says 'This certificate requires a total of 23-26 units' while the course table prints 'Total Units 23-27'. total_units records the description's 23-26; reviewer should check.

The 'Required Core' heading (12-15 units) spans both the English composition requirement (4-5) and the foreign language pathway choice (8-10); the 12-15 and 8-10 figures are not recorded on any single block's stated.
ENGL C1000 appears twice in the table (as the main row and as an 'or' row); recorded once with ENGL C1000E and ESL 110 C as alternatives. The 4-5 range printed beside it covers the alternatives.

Foreign language pathways printed as pairs separated by 'OR'; each pair recorded as its own block in option_group 'Foreign Language Pathway'. Pathway block names are descriptive labels derived from the courses, not printed headings.
The four HRC courses listed (with HRC 160 C or HRC 230 C) total 11 units, matching the minimum of the 11-12 unit elective range, so in practice all may be required; HRC 230 C units not printed.
Program outcomes are printed for the program on the outcomes tab; this certificate is the only award in the section, so they are recorded here. 'OUTCOME n:' labels omitted.
